test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 18 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

His (1)___ speech was clear, (2)___ and passionate, leaving a (3)___ impression on the audience during the conference.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "**persuasive**" means convincing or able to influence others effectively.
 
• The phrase "**well-structured**" refers to speech or writing that is organized logically and flows smoothly.
 
• The term "**lasting**" indicates something that leaves a deep and enduring impression.
 
• Option 1 correctly fits the blanks in the sentence, making it the most appropriate choice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His persuasive__ speech was clear, __well-structured__, and passionate, leaving a __lasting__ impression on the audience during the conference.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Well-structured:** Refers to logical and organized content.
 
• **Persuasive:** Refers to content that is influential and convincing.
 
• **Lasting:** Refers to something that creates a deep, enduring impact.
